media.prompt: Ming Image 0.1 Design: Image Edit: sample from ComfyUI's template library
media.note: From ComfyUI's template library (MIT). Not rendered on this machine yet.

what: Edit an existing image with Ming Image 0.1 Design, a 6B model tuned for UI, infographics, and posters. It takes one input image plus the boxes you draw on it — position, description, and colour palette — and rebuilds them into a layer-by-layer caption, returning one re-rendered image. Ideal for restaging a layout, poster-style re-renders, and turning a photograph into a designed composition.
